about: Coalition Builder warnings. Each rule fires when its `when` condition holds for the selected parties. Conditions: {"party": id} selected; {"tag": t} any selected party carries tag t; {"all": [...]}, {"any": [...]}. Message placeholders: {and:tag1,tag2} joins the selected parties with those tags with " and "; {comma:tag} joins with ", ".

rules.message: Selected parties with recorded pledges to govern without Arab parties: {comma:noArabPledge}. This coalition includes {and:arab}.
Eisenkot said on Sept 26 that Mansour Abbas “won't be part of my next government.”
Bennett's B'Yachad pledged to govern only with Zionist parties: no Arab or Haredi parties. This coalition includes {and:haredi,arab}.
rules.source: Times of Israel, Apr 26 and May 27, 2026

rules.message: Liberman: “not for the Arab parties and not for the haredi parties.” This coalition includes {and:haredi,arab}.
The Joint List says it won't join Netanyahu.
UTJ says it will not support or enter any government that does not first regulate the status of Torah learners (a yeshiva-status law), whoever leads it.
